# OpenThesis 2.0.1

OpenThesis 2.0.1 is a Windows x64 portable release focused on restoring the model catalog and making the `.ot` Studio workflow dependable.

## Highlights

- Built-in offline model candidates, stable online discovery merging, and an advanced manual-model fallback.
- User-triggered connection-level and configured-model-level tests.
- API keys stored locally through Windows Credential Manager; secrets are not placed in SQLite, reports, logs, or `.ot` packages.
- Correct, locally bundled provider icons with offline rendering support.
- More consistent `.ot` Studio buttons and readable, accessible parameter tooltips.
- Deterministic `.ot` package compilation, import validation, content hashing, and persistence after restart.
- Compatible with an Ollama installation already present on the user's machine; OpenThesis does not bundle Ollama or model weights.

## Known limitations

- Windows is the current platform with a formal binary release.
- A complete end-to-end research run against a real paid model was not part of this final acceptance cycle.
- MinerU is only used after a local extraction failure, page preview, and per-page user confirmation; no MinerU upload was performed in this cycle.
- The complete manual screen-reader audit is not finished.
- OpenThesis does not provide automatic trading or guarantee investment returns.
